optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Engineer, Mine Fleet Dispatch System
professionalSummary: Dispatch software engineer with four years of experience delivering algorithm and interface work for a fleet dispatch system in compliance with mine operations specialists' specifications and the dispatch software standard.
Carried pager on the dispatch on‑call rota across three control rooms, handling 52 night calls including nine stopped‑fleet incidents with documented restoration times and control room sign‑offs.
Proved every change on the mine simulator before review, maintaining simulator records and obtaining countersignatures from a second engineer.
Managed dispatch software review and release processes, ensuring approvals from the dispatch software lead and recording personal responsibility boundaries.
Documented written boundaries and hand‑over notes for every change in the change record closure section.

role.roleTitle: Software Engineer, Mine Fleet Dispatch System

evidence.text: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of delivery of algorithm and interface work per specifications.

evidence.text: Carried the pager on the dispatch on‑call rota for the whole four years across the three control rooms; the on‑call log lists fifty‑two night calls under my name, nine of them stopped‑fleet incidents, each with the time to restore and the control room's sign‑off that the fleet was moving again.
evidence.notes: Explicit log of night calls and stopped‑fleet incidents.

evidence.text: Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer.
evidence.notes: Direct proof of simulator usage and record keeping.

evidence.text: Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine.
evidence.notes: Shows review process and lead approval.

evidence.text: Behind every change there is a boundary and hand‑over note in the change record's closure section, stating what the change does not cover.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of written boundary and hand‑over note.
